name: piston_cylinder_spring_water
title: Water heated in a spring-loaded piston-cylinder (exercise 4.21)
summary: A frictionless piston-cylinder holds 4 kg of saturated water at 35 °C. The piston rests on stops, lifts at 300 kPa, then compresses a spring while heating continues to 7 MPa. The model computes the final state and the boundary work. Teaching exercise 4.21 of the French edition of Cengel.
